about.title: So, who’s this *guy?*
paragraphs: Just a guy who says “how hard can it be?” way too often.
Into technology, software, design, business, and poking at how stuff works. Whether or not anyone asked.
No master plan. I learn things, try things, mess things up, and somehow figure it out along the way. Don’t ask me how.
facts: Has too many ideas. Send help.
Can turn “I wonder if this works” into an unnecessarily long project.
“Just a small tweak” has never once been small.
Reads the manual. Right after everything catches fire.
